tasks.title: Extract the tool slot from the editor store into tool-slot.ts, with the store's public API and its tests unchanged
tasks.dod: src/features/editor/tool-slot.ts holds activeTool, openTool, closeTool and the per-tool previews, the editor store composes it, and every existing editor, crop-rotate and adjust test passes unchanged

tasks.title: Add src/core/draw: palette and defaults, parseWidth and stepWidth, Catmull–Rom segments, segment bounds and footprintReachesCrop
tasks.dod: Vitest proves the AC-02 palette order and defaults, the AC-03 width-field table, stepWidth clamping (195 + 10 = 200), Catmull–Rom control points passing through every point, and footprintReachesCrop for paths inside, outside and grazing the Crop

tasks.title: Add frameToOriginal to the Geometry transform and deviceToFrame to the View, both unit-tested against the existing UV transform
tasks.dod: Vitest proves frameToOriginal agrees with cropToOriginalUv scaled to pixels for every Rotation, a Flip, a Straighten angle and a Crop, keeps lengths, and that deviceToFrame inverts the View at any zoom and pan

tasks.title: Add Work.drawing (DrawingLayer | null) and the render/drawing layer module: create, copy, release with ledger counts, readRect and hasAnyMark
tasks.dod: createWork sets drawing null; layer tests prove create is W₀×H₀ transparent, copy is independent, release sets the canvas to 0×0 and is counted, readRect returns straight pixels and hasAnyMark detects one alpha>0 pixel

tasks.title: Add the painter: paintSegment and paintDot with Brush source-over and Eraser destination-out under setTransform(frameToOriginal) and clip(crop), the dirty rectangle and the alpha-lowered check
tasks.dod: Painter tests with a recording 2D context prove the composite mode per mode, round caps and joins, the transform and clip set per segment inside save/restore, the dirty rectangle grows by bounds + width/2 + 2 px clamped to the layer, and alphaLowered compares the rectangle before and after

tasks.title: Composite the layer in the shared shader (u_layer, u_draw) and add PreviewRenderer.setLayer and updateLayer with context-loss restore
tasks.dod: Shader and renderer tests prove u_draw false skips the block, the layer binds to unit 1 with the same filters as the Original, setLayer uploads only when the bitmap differs, updateLayer uploads one texSubImage2D rect and regenerates mipmaps below 100%, a lost context re-uploads the layer, and sampleCrop keeps u_draw off

tasks.title: Give the tool slot the 'draw' tool: keep Crop and View on open, previewLayer and setPreviewLayer, layerChanged, applyDrawing with the change flag, ExportSnapshot.drawing and the export refusal text
tasks.dod: Editor store tests prove openTool('draw') leaves the View and previewGeometry untouched, setPreviewLayer is accepted only while draw is open, applyDrawing stores the layer with a new id, raises the revision only when changed, releases the previous layer and is ignored during an export, replace and closeTool clear previewLayer, and beginExport snapshots the applied layer

tasks.title: Make PreviewCanvas show the Draft or the Work's layer, and give the e2e hooks a reference drawing, a scripted Stroke, a layered previewAt100 and the layer ledger
tasks.dod: PreviewCanvas tests prove the renderer gets previewLayer while draw is open and work.drawing otherwise (null after Clear shows no marks), and the e2e hooks expose setReferenceDrawing, paintStroke, layer ledger counts and a previewAt100 that includes the layer

tasks.title: Spike the hot path: a @perf e2e that paints scripted Strokes through the hooks at 1 px and 200 px, at Fit and at 100%, and records the frame interval and the pointer-to-frame latency
tasks.dod: e2e/draw/perf.spec.ts (@perf, PERF=1) reports p95 frame interval and pointer-to-frame latency for the four cases on the reference machine, the numbers and any chosen fallback are written into the epic Risks section, and the suite is skipped without PERF=1

tasks.title: Send the applied layer to the export worker and its window fallback, render it in one or two passes, and make the crop-transparency check include the layer
tasks.dod: Worker-handler, client and export-store tests prove ExportRequest and AlphaRequest carry the layer as transferred ImageData, single pass only at full size or with neutral Adjustments and no layer, the identity short-cut applies only when work.drawing is null, and the alpha cache key includes the layer id

tasks.title: Add the draw store: open with a copy of the layer, mode reset to Brush, colour and width kept until reload, width field and steps, Clear with the change flag, Apply, Cancel and release on replace
tasks.dod: Draw store tests with a real editor store prove the open state (Brush, last colour and width, Red 12 px first), the Draft is a copy or null, the width field rules and steps, Clear sets the flag only when a mark existed, Apply hands the Draft with the flag, Cancel releases it, and a replace releases it — with the layer ledger balanced

tasks.title: Add the Stroke session: map coalesced positions through the View, paint Catmull–Rom segments and dots, set the change flag, flush the dirty rectangle once per frame, and hold input until the pointer is released
tasks.dod: Stroke-session tests with a fake painter and a fake rAF prove each position maps with the View current at its event, segments paint one point behind and the last on release, a click paints one dot, an empty Draft gets a layer only for the Brush, the flag follows footprint and alphaLowered, one layerChanged per frame, deferred settings apply from the next Stroke, Enter waits for release, and Escape, cancel, blur and a second pointer behave as AC-18 says

tasks.title: Add the 'Draw' toolbar action with its hints, the D shortcut and the message catalog, mounted after 'Adjust'
tasks.dod: DrawAction and shortcut tests prove the action's pressed, disabled-during-export and aria-disabled-with-hint states, D opens the tool letter-first then by key position, D is silent under the export panel, with the tool open, in a text field and during an export, and shows the open-an-image and apply-or-cancel hints

tasks.title: Add an optional swatch to SegmentedControl, register it, and build DrawControls: mode, palette, custom colour, width slider and field, Clear, Cancel and Apply
tasks.dod: Primitive tests prove a swatch option renders a filled square with label as accessible name and null selects nothing; DrawControls tests prove the panel order, the palette order and marking, custom colour selection, the width field rules on blur and Enter without applying, and Clear / Cancel / Apply calling the store

tasks.title: Build DrawOverlay: pointer capture with coalesced positions into the Stroke session, the width circle at width × zoom, the hidden cursor over the image, Space-drag pass-through and a second touch
tasks.dod: Overlay tests prove a main-button press captures the pointer and feeds begin/move/end with coalesced points (or the event when unsupported), pointercancel / blur / a second pointer end the Stroke, Space held lets the drag through, and the circle diameter is width × zoom and hidden outside the shown image

tasks.title: Mount DrawTool in the tool slot with the overlay, add the in-tool keys B, E, [ ], Enter and Escape, focus on open and close, and the tool-ready mark
tasks.dod: DrawTool and shortcut tests prove the tool mounts only while 'draw' is open, B/E/[ ]/Enter/Escape follow screens.md §Keyboard including the text-field and focused-button rules and key-position fallbacks, focus goes to the mode group on open and back to Draw on close, and a 'tool ready' performance mark is set on first draw

tasks.title: Add the e2e fidelity suite: reference drawing vs Preview at 100% for each Geometry case and with Adjustments, empty layer = 0, Geometry round trips = 0, image pixels unchanged outside marks, smaller sizes and the transparency hint
tasks.dod: e2e/draw/fidelity.spec.ts passes on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit: ±2/255 Export vs previewAt100 for every case, difference 0 for the empty-layer and round-trip rows, exact pixels outside the mark mask, a red mark stays red at grayscale 100%, and the JPEG hint matches the drawn result

tasks.title: Add the e2e tool-flow suite: the live line through every position, a dot, the Eraser, Clear, Apply and Cancel, the clip at the Crop, drag vs pan and zoom in the tool, the keyboard path and the layer ledger
tasks.dod: e2e/draw/tool.spec.ts passes on all three engines (path rules on Chromium): the line passes every scripted position and is unchanged after release, a click paints a dot, the Eraser and Clear uncover the image, Cancel and Escape restore the layer, a Stroke outside the Crop leaves no mark later, drag draws while Space-drag and wheel pan and zoom, the keyboard-only path works, and the ledger retains one or zero layers

tasks.title: Add the e2e cross-feature suite: Unsaved edits rules, export and Ctrl/Cmd+S refused while drawing, one tool at a time in both directions, Draw refused during an export and with no image, replace while open, and marks in Crop and rotate and Adjust
tasks.dod: e2e/draw/cross-feature.spec.ts passes on all three engines for every AC listed, including the Unsaved-edits table of AC-12, Ctrl/Cmd+S never opening Save page, and Crop and rotate showing marks outside the frame

tasks.title: Complete the @perf suite: drawing frame interval and latency through the real overlay, tool-ready, Apply / Cancel / Clear and Crop-and-rotate Apply over a full layer, export time with a full layer, and memory after 50 Applies
tasks.dod: With PERF=1 on the reference machine every spec §6 timing and memory row is measured and within target at Fit and at 100%, and the export perf test passes repeated with a full Drawing layer
